changes.title: Witch pool
items: Your light pool is warm amber on grass, not lime, and it shows again on dark forest floors like the fern forest's

changes.title: Fen punt
items: The fen's sunken punt is now grown from its own seed: slanting in a reedy pool, its pole stuck in the mud

changes.title: Magic dodge
items: Your dodge leaves a moonlit afterimage where you stood and a smear along the way, instead of a white flash
Your broom drops a few amber sparks as you fly, and the speed spell's trail is warm amber and rose
